# ReplyEngine

> ReplyEngine is an AI-powered Google review response management platform for small businesses. It automatically drafts personalized review responses, detects fake and policy-violating reviews for dispute, and runs private recovery outreach to unhappy customers. ReplyEngine is an affordable alternative to Birdeye ($299/month) and Podium ($249-399/month), starting free with paid plans at $19/month and $39/month.

ReplyEngine serves local businesses including restaurants, contractors, dental offices, salons, law firms, auto shops, hotels, and any business with a Google Business Profile. The platform uses Claude AI to generate responses that match each business's unique voice and tone. Key capabilities include one-tap response approval, automatic fake review detection using 12 signals, private email and SMS recovery outreach to unhappy customers, review analytics with sentiment tracking, and multi-location support.

## Core Features
- [AI Review Response Generation](https://replyengine.com/features/ai-responses): Drafts personalized responses to every Google review in under 30 seconds
- [Fake Review Dispute Detection](https://replyengine.com/features/dispute-detection): Scans reviews for policy violations and fake review patterns using 12 signals
- [Customer Recovery Outreach](https://replyengine.com/features/recovery): Private email and SMS outreach to unhappy customers
- [Review Analytics Dashboard](https://replyengine.com/features/analytics): Sentiment tracking, review velocity, star distribution
- [Multi-Location Management](https://replyengine.com/features/multi-location): Manage reviews across multiple business locations

## Pricing
- [Pricing Plans](https://replyengine.com/pricing): Free plan (5 AI responses/month, 1 location), Starter ($19/month, unlimited responses, 3 locations), Pro ($39/month, unlimited everything)
